messages:
maria: Heads up — profiling run on a 16k longpref workload showed steady KV slab growth for Qwen-v1 at ~8k tokens, then a sharp residency oscillation after rope-rescale around 10k. attaching short dump in case people see the pattern :eyes:
cheng: can you paste the mini profile? noticed similar with Mistral but didn't dig in yet
anita: fyi we saw a different shape on Llama-MQA — fragmentation more than growth, pages not getting coalesced after eviction
ops-bot: snapshot created: s3://redwood-dev/kvcapture/4443219876/dump-1.tar.gz
maria: small excerpt:```
KV pages: total=4096 resident=3120 free=976
slab-alloc: chunks=780 avg-usage=0.68
rope-scale-event: old=512 new=1024
post-rescale-resident=3900 (growth +25%)
evicts/sec spiked -> 1200
```
lee: that spike during rope rescale suggests kernel choice switched to a linear fallback which increased hot-page churn. which kernel was selected?
maria: runtime logs show kernel=attn_v2_mqa_fallback at 4443219901, then later kernel=attn_v1_generic at 4443219920
tom: switching kernels during mid-request is bad — we've seen rollover thrash when the kernel changes cache access pattern (prefetch -> conservative). causes extra dirty pages
cheng: Qwen's key/value layout uses interleaved stripes; when rope-scale doubles, pointer offsets shift and our compactness heuristic fails to remap, leaving small orphaned fragments
anita: Llama-MQA had coalescer disabled under quantized path, which explained fragmentation. enabling coalescer cut fragmentation by ~40% in local repro
lee: idea: pin kernel for longpref runs (force attn_v1_generic) and rerun to see if eviction rate drops. also try bumping batch-heuristic max-batch-delay from 8ms->16ms to reduce micro-batching churn
maria: agreed — will run 3 experiments: (1) pin kernel, (2) enable coalescer for quantized lanes, (3) increase batch delay. capturing telemetry each minute
ops-bot: perf test queued: perf-run/4443219876/exp-1 (pin-kernel)
cheng: for Qwen test also add a layout-rewrite that nudges page compaction after rescale: run compact-after-rescale=true for 1 minute window
anita: note: coalescer has a perf cost on short sequences — add a gating by seq_len>2k so we only pay on longpref
maria: I reproduced local: with pin-kernel eviction rate went from 1200->320 evicts/sec and resident plateaued. will upload traces
lee: sounds like kernel switch is the primary trigger. then fragmentation/coalescer decisions amplify it per model. good hunting! :thumbsup:
tom: action: maria runs exp, cheng wires compact-after-rescale, anita toggles coalescer gating, lee measures batch-delay effect. report back in this thread by EOD PST
maria: uploading traces now, link s3://redwood-dev/kvcapture/4443219876/trace-pin-kernel.json.gz
cheng: one more ask — include kernel selection logs (we need timestamps around selection) and the batching trace so we can correlate prefetch events
maria: will include both. thanks all, looping in infra if we need kernel-level rollbacks @ops-bot
ops-bot: noted. escalation path: eng-runtime -> eng-infra if root cause needs kernel patching
maria: thanks — will post results shortly.
